summary: Manual local deploy script (deploy/deploy-local.sh): sudo-gated, CI-green-gated, additive to Actions
description: GH Actions deploy queue is slow (cold runner + npm ci ~6-8 min per merge). deploy.sh on the VPS only consumes pre-built tarballs over the tailnet, so a local builder is contract-compatible. Requirements from user: sudo-gated (human-presence authorization), strictly manual, does NOT displace deploy.yml (stays canonical/fallback). Guards: sudo -v; node major must match deploy.yml's 20; sha = origin/main HEAD only (fetched fresh); all GitHub check-runs for that sha successful via gh api; explicit confirm prompt. Hygiene: builds in a detached git worktree of the sha (never the working tree), mirrors deploy.yml exactly — fetch /etc/guru-web.public.env from VPS, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED build, npm prune --omit=dev, smoke-boot on :3210, tar with the same excludes, scp to releases/.incoming, ssh deploy.sh <sha>.

resolution.note: Gates verified piecemeal (CI query green 2/2, node gate fires on v22, tailnet host reachable); no deploy executed — awaiting operator ssh setup
